rule_summary: Québec residents must have qualifying prescription drug coverage for the whole year, either through a private/group plan or the RAMQ public plan, unless a statutory exemption applies. On the income tax return, Schedule K calculates any prescription drug insurance premium from the month-by-month coverage and exemption facts that Revenu Québec asks for. Having a job does not by itself prove group prescription drug coverage — the employer/internship plan must actually include basic prescription drug insurance. Coverage and exemption status can differ month by month.
uncertainty_notes: Whether an internship/employment plan included BASIC PRESCRIPTION DRUG coverage must be confirmed from plan documents, not inferred from employment.
Health insurance registration is not the same thing as prescription-drug coverage for Schedule K.
Thresholds, exemptions, and the Schedule K premium formula change each tax year — verify against the current-year guide.
